sloka: दिदेश राजा रुचिरं रामाय परमासनम् ।तदासनवरं प्राप्य व्यदीपयत राघवः ॥२-३-३५॥
transliteration: dideśa rājā ruciraṁ rāmāya paramāsanam ।tadāsanavaraṁ prāpya vyadīpayata rāghavaḥ ॥2-3-35॥

translations.english: The lofty seat Rama occupied was illuminated by him resplenderce like mount Meru in the translucent rays of the morning Sun.
